semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Orient Service Corp. provides equipment and solutions relevant to semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in exhaust gas treatment and vacuum systems.
summary: Orient Service Corp. specializes in exhaust gas treatment systems and vacuum solutions, catering to semiconductor manufacturing and service providers. They also offer hydrogen energy solutions, including hydrogen production equipment and fuel cells, which may support semiconductor applications in energy efficiency.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Orient Service Corp. was established in Taiwan and has been serving global manufacturers and distributors since 1982.
